suggestions: I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally passed on the third re-run instead of haunting me into the weekend.
I'm thankful for the uncle at the mamak who tops up my teh tarik without me asking twice.
I'm grateful for the ten minutes of quiet before Subuh when the group chats haven't woken up yet.
I'm thankful for a PR review that came back with actual useful comments instead of just LGTM.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a job offer letter that finally came through after months of interviews.
I'm thankful for my dad still waiting up to unlock the gate even though I told him not to bother.
I'm grateful for a production incident that turned out to be a stale cache and not something I broke.
I'm thankful for the cab driver who turned the radio down without me saying anything, just read the room.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that caught a bug before it ever reached a customer.
I'm thankful for the first sip of air kosong after a long Zuhur khutbah on a hot day.
I'm grateful for a laptop fan that held on for one more year instead of dying mid-sprint.
I'm thankful for my mum's voice note reminding me to eat, sent at the exact moment I forgot lunch.
I'm grateful for a junior on the team asking a question that made me realize I'd been doing it wrong too.
I'm thankful for the balcony breeze after a thunderstorm, laptop closed, nothing left on the board for today.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a landlord who fixed the leaking pipe same day instead of making excuses.
